# vsop87_earth_data.cpp and moon_tables_data.cpp are generated by
# scripts/data/gen_astro_tables.py (see the file headers for their sources).

ds_add_core_module(astro
    SOURCES
        events.cpp
        module.cpp
        moon_tables_data.cpp
        nutation.cpp
        sky_coordinates.cpp
        stars.cpp
        sun_moon.cpp
        time.cpp
        vsop87_earth_data.cpp
    DEPS
        ds::geo
        ds::common)

# Star catalogue for the night sky (FR-AST-08), loaded with ds::astro::loadStarCatalog().
install(FILES ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/sky/bsc5.csv
    DESTINATION ${DS_INSTALL_DATADIR}/sky
    COMPONENT runtime)
